reviews.x: I absolutely love this product.  I just had my bathroom done and I had a wrap around tub and walls put in.  This suctions nicely to the walls.  I keep a towel and my sponge brush on it.  Another reviewer said after installing this suction cup, wait a day and turn it a little tighter, I did that once.  My hook has held fast since May.  Love it and highly recommend it.

These hooks serve my purpose. I put them inside and the outside of our ceramic tile showers. It took me a couple of times to get them up, but I have the hang of it. If you moisten the inside of the Rubber cup and make sure the wall is clean, apply pressure  they will tighten up nicely. I would recommend, they are sturdy enough to carry robes towels etc. love the bronze color too.

Love this product!!!  Works great! Well constructed- doesn't mark up the walls. And unlike another brand name it doesn't fall apart when you try to use it. I bought a similar product from another brand - complete junk!  Pinnacle Brands is great!!  This product works!!!!

Love the Gecko shower suctions! They seriously are the best I've found so far. I purchased the shower shelf about two months ago and I'm so happy with it. I never have to fuss with it falling down. With that being said, I decided I'd like a hook for the shower for my loofahs and it does a mighty fine job. Easy installation too!
I love these.  They are sturdier than the other options and far more attractive.  They fit perfectly on my subway tiles and match my black fixtures.  So glad I invested the extra dollars in them.

The first time I attached it my shower wall (dry, non porous ceramic tile) it stayed for a few hours and eventually fell off. So I read over the instructions again and basically screwed down the the suction as hard as could and as far as it would go, left it alone for 24 hours and when I thought it was safely in place, I hung the shower caddy on it (our shower head is too high to hang showers caddies on). And 3 days later it is still hanging tight! I hope it continues to work. I will update my r

reviews.t: but applied a little baby oil and stuck to shower wall great. Looks nice and works as desired
reviews.x: Works well, would be 5 star, but appeared to be used and not new.  Didn't stick the first time, but applied a little baby oil and stuck to shower wall great.  Looks nice and works as desired.

This hook is GREAT. After fighting with a different one which kept falling and eventually broke, I tried this hook. It has stayed on for months now. I loved it so much I went back and ordered the basket which you can see hanging behind it in my photos. That is holding large and heavy hair product bottles and has never slipped at all. These hooks are FABULOUS! Also I love the ball-end on the double hook because the towel or whatever you want to hang on it does not get damaged or stretched at a si

Used this to hang a hand towel on a bathroom mirror because there was no open wall space near the sink to install a typical bar/hook. It looks good, grips tightly (it's never fallen off), holds the towel up, and keeps us from having to reach across the room and drip water everywhere. We got one at our old house 1-2 years ago, and another for our new house when we moved. We mounted them on glass, but they also come with a super sticky pad if you want to mount it on other surfaces. Highly recommen
This works exactly as promised!!!! I've had the whole set up since March or April and haven't had a single issue. They're very sturdy and have never fallen off.
This hooker was well worth the money. Very sturdy and screws in to lock in place and hold up even heavy towels.
This is working so well in the shower.  Looks great too!

reviews.t: Beyond my expectations for Glass Shower Door Hook
reviews.x: I was so happy when I finally found a shower door hook that did not require drilling a hole (obviously you would not want to do that in glass; my thoughtless contractor did not account for a towel bar or hook and there is no where close so I had to have a coat rack and it was unsightly and took space and ruined the look of my beautiful new bath). First i was pleased because it comes in the Rubbed Bronze finish I love and most importantly the suction is so strong and the hook has two arms so you

reviews.t: Very Powerful Suction Cup Hook – Displays Nicely With Decor!!!
reviews.x: I am extremely impressed with the staying power and suction grip of this heavy-duty Gecko-Loc suction cup hook.  The original hook was purchased to hang a decorative sign on the front door which has frosted glass.  The wood sign is staying up so well, that I purchased two more Gecko-Loc hooks for interior locations.  The décor of this hook is versatile, displays very nicely and blends well with my rustic décor.  The Gecko-Loc hook deserves a 5 star rating in quality, function and décor style.  I

This came in fairly quick, installed it in my shower it's marble. Followed the instructions and basically used the hook to hold my wash cloth. It lasted up about 3-4 days. When it landed it scratched my new tub and I decided not to put it back up. Not real good suction I think and the way it works with time and moisture you need to be aware. If your tile isn't smooth this may not work. The 3m glue pad is another option but on seems extreme and I don't want to risk damaging my marble tile.

Ordered 4. Put 2 on glass shower doors in downstairs shower and 2 on subway tile in upstairs shower.  These stick really well, good suction but easy to move and re-arrange.  They did not stick to the tile in my downstairs shower but that tile was smaller than the backing so it could not get good suction. On regular subway tile upstairs they stick just fine.  I even use it sometimes to hold the handle of my hand held shower wand down lower.  No issues.  Would order again.

reviews.t: Poor Suction but Looks Very Nice
reviews.x: The product looks very nice and is decent, heavy quality. Unfortunately, it fell off the wall almost immediately (smooth, non-porous tile, not over a grout line, cleaned properly, suction cup starting flat as directed, tightened after 15 minutes, etc). There is an option to use an adhesive disk between the product and the tile, but I do not want to stick something to my tile, only to find that the hook falls off that smooth surface also.

reviews.t: I Attached This Hook to a Window
reviews.x: I purchased this heavy duty suction cup hook to see if it would adhere to the inside of a window in my home so that I could hang a beautiful 12-inch round suncatcher I received as a birthday gift.  Well, it did the trick.  The suncatcher is hanging there and the hook is strong and stable.  I don't anticipate any problems with this solution to my suncatcher problem.

I like that I could get this in black to match my color scheme in the bathroom. I use this on my shower wall to hold the shower squeegee and it works great. For some reason it won't stick to my kitchen sink so I had to use the sticky holder to hang it on there. This is a very sturdy product and this is my second purchase.

This is great!  We do have a stone tile throughout the shower that does have a texture but this hook is solid in my shower. It has been hanging for a few weeks and doesn't budge and acts as if I have truly secured it into the tile. I needed a dark color to match my fixtures and it looks nice and does the job.

reviews.t: Nice sturdy product with best suction characteristics
reviews.x: Attractive finish, nicely constructed and a fabulous suction attachment system that stays attached, is rugged and easy to use! You couldn’t ask for a better product for its intended use; a winner and Uber attractive design in matte black which is all the rage for retro master bathes ; fashionable too!

Purchased this and the small basket several weeks ago and it has stayed attached to the wall of my shower since that time. I have a washcloth and a lava stone hanging from it all the time. Hasn't budged an inch. I highly recommend these to anyone needing some extra storage in their shower.

reviews.t: These Did Not Work For Me
reviews.x: I bought a pair of them and used them on porcelain tile.  I followed the instructions and they fell off under their own weight. I then tried them with super glue to no avail.  I then tried them with epoxy and again they fell off.  I am trying one more time with two sided tape.

I had this up in my shower for a week before it fell off. It was holding a small shower caddy with only a few things on it (see photos). I hung it back up and it stayed for 2 days before falling again. This is a terrible product. I should've ordered something else.

reviews.t: Color and overall quality is nice. Unfortunately
reviews.x: Color and overall quality is nice. Unfortunately, it did not hold on my ceramic tile wall for longer than an hour (and I followed the installation instructions). After it fell off for the third time and scratched my newly-installed bathtub, I gave up on it.

claims.text: Most reviewers find the suction strong and reliable, with hooks staying up for months and holding heavy items.
Several reviewers note it takes a few tries or following instructions carefully (moistening the cup, tightening hard, waiting 24 hours) before it holds securely.
Reviewers praise the build quality and appearance, calling it sturdy and attractive compared to other brands.
A few reviewers report the hook failed to stick and fell off, in one case scratching a tub.
Some reviewers mention it outperforms other brands that fell apart or kept falling.
